snippet.title: WARDOGS | 10 Reasons NOT to Buy
snippet.description:
Pre-order WARDOGS now on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1867240/WARDOGS/

Here are 10 reasons you should NOT buy WARDOGS.

Pre-ordering will guarantee you access to our Closed Beta weekend on the 21st August 2026. If you don't enjoy the Closed Beta, it's totally okay to refund the game.
Alternatively, you can sign up to playtest via steam for a random chance at access.

WARDOGS Early Access will release on the 10th September 2026.
You've watched, you've listened... now is the time to play.
